antipatterns.message: Use app.add(tag, { to: task.tags }) instead of .addTag()
clearTags() not supported in JXA. Iterate with app.remove().
Exact tag name matching fails when names contain Unicode/emoji. Use .toLowerCase().includes() for lookup.
.byName() returns null when not found. Assign to a variable and null-check before property access. Example: var t = flattenedTags.byName(x); if (!t) return; t.use();
selection arrays may be empty. Check .length before [0] access. Example: if (selection.tasks.length === 0) { return; } var t = selection.tasks[0];

PlugIn.find() returns null when the plugin is missing. Assign and null-check before .library() access. Example: var p = PlugIn.find(id); if (!p) { new Alert('Required plugin missing', '...').show(); return; }
Use LanguageModel.Schema.fromJSON({...}) factory, not the constructor. The constructor doesn't accept JSON schema input.
